```{r setup,warning=F,message=F}
library(tidyverse)

potholes <- read_csv("Street_Pothole_Work_Orders_-_Closed_(Dataset)_20260918.csv")

p <- potholes %>%
  transmute(closed = floor_date(ymd_hms(RptClosed), unit = "months"),
         reported = floor_date(ymd_hms(RptDate), unit = "months"),
         delay = difftime(ymd_hms(RptClosed),ymd_hms(RptDate),units = "days")) %>%
  pivot_longer(-delay,
               names_to = "type",
               values_to = "month") %>%
  group_by(type,month) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            avg_delay = mean(delay)) %>%
  filter(month >= ymd("20160101")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(mamdani = year(month) == 2026,
         month_fct = month(month,label = T),
         # Set January 2026 as reference for intercept estimate
         month_n = interval(ymd("20260101"), month) %/% months(1))
```


```{r fig_n,warning=F,message=F}
ggplot(p,
       aes(x=month,y=n,color=type)) +
  #facet_wrap(~Boro,ncol = 1) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  labs(x="Month",y="Number of potholes reported/fixed")
```


```{r fig_delay,warning=F,message=F}
ggplot(filter(p,type=="reported"),
       aes(x=month,y=avg_delay)) +
  #facet_wrap(~Boro,ncol = 1) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  labs(x="Month",y="Average days to fix")
```


```{r model,warning=F,message=F}
#Get effect size at average month
contrasts(p$month_fct) <- contr.sum(nlevels(p$month_fct))

pothole_mod <- lm(n ~ mamdani + month_n + month_fct,
   data = p[p$type == "closed",])

summary(pothole_mod)

```
